The white ties appear to emerge from the edge of the bib without a clear reinforced seam or hem channel, looking slightly fused or physically implausible in their attachment point.

To verify the physical connectivity of the ties to the main body and check for edge bleeding into the carpet background.
To analyze the consistency of the plaid pattern and detect any subtle warping or melting in the textile design.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'ties' at the neck. In AI images, these often float or merge incorrectly with the main body. Also, inspect the plaid pattern for any 'wavy' lines that break the geometric grid, which would indicate texture generation failure.
